'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 John Anderson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
